description: Association of an ordinary app.bsky.feed.post to a group's timeline. Lives in the AUTHOR's repo. Keeps the underlying post a standard post (threads/embeds/likes/moderation work unchanged); the group binding is layered metadata. Mirrors app.bsky.graph.listitem, but the subject is a post rather than an actor.

subject.description: Strong reference to the app.bsky.feed.post being associated. The post lives in the same repo as this record.

group.description: The target com.authorityone.group.profile record. OPEN (Q1): option (a), the default, names the group by AT-URI only (no cid), since a pinned cid dangles after every owner edit of the profile; option (b) also pins the profile cid at posting time. Bindings written as a strongRef ({uri, cid}) stay valid.
